plan.composition: Full width, no side panel. A short header names the result. Below it, the body is a set of Tabs - one per direction, labelled by theme name - since these are options of equal weight meant to be compared one at a time rather than scanned as a grid. Each tab opens on its title-slide mockup large and edge to edge at the top (the figure a person looks for first), then the theme's identity beneath it in two halves via Split: the palette as Swatches on the left, the typography, layout and style details as a column of Detail lines on the right, with the exclusions given its own line at the bottom. Nothing from the request is restated - the host's bar already carries the topic. The first tab opens by default.

brief:
# Result page: slide_designer.generate_design_proposals_from_rough_brief

Transform a design brief into multiple visual directions, each a theme with a title slide drawn in it

## Frame

This page is the result page of an app that is composed, then shows its result: what the person sees after one run. The host draws what surrounds it: the band with the team's logo and the app's name, then a bar restating the request with a way back to edit it and to run again. The host also owns the actions on the result, such as downloading or sharing it, and places them where the page's header puts them. There is no side panel, no app bar and no footer to build, and nothing restates the request.

The page is the result across the full width. It opens on its header, which names the result in a person's words, read from the result itself where it can be (the page's h1). Then the figure or the fact a person looks for first, then the body of the result in the shape it naturally has: a plan day by day, options side by side to compare, a record's details. Lay out what a person reads; leave out what only a machine would.

Show each value once: a figure a component already states, such as the total inside a ProportionBar, is not repeated beside it. When the result carries the request back - the same facts the person entered, such as the topic or the tone they chose - leave that part out: the host's bar already restates the request. Write a value as a person reads it: a date in words, an amount beside its currency when the result has one.

## State

The host loads the run's result under `/result` before the page renders. Read every value with `$state`; emit no `/state` patches. Paths:

- `/result` — structure slide_designer.DesignDirections: The visual directions proposed for a deck, each a theme with a title slide drawn in it
  - `/result/directions` — list of structure slide_designer.Direction — `directions`: The directions, one per theme
    - each item is a structure slide_designer.Direction (One visual direction for a deck: its theme, and a title slide drawn in it), with these members (paths relative to one item, for DataTable columns or $item):
      - `theme` — structure slide_designer.Theme — `theme`: The direction's theme: name, palette, type, layout and style
        - `theme/name` — text — `name`: Theme name identifier
        - `theme/colors` — structure slide_designer.ColorPalette — `colors`: Color palette for the theme
          - `theme/colors/primary` — text — `primary`: Primary brand color (hex or name)
          - `theme/colors/secondary` — text — `secondary`: Secondary color for accents
          - `theme/colors/accent` — text — `accent`: Accent color for highlights
          - `theme/colors/background` — text — `background`: Background color
          - `theme/colors/text_primary` — text — `text_primary`: Primary text color
          - `theme/colors/text_secondary` — text — `text_secondary`: Secondary text color for subtitles
        - `theme/typography` — structure slide_designer.Typography — `typography`: Typography settings
          - `theme/typography/font_family` — text — `font_family`: Primary font family name
          - `theme/typography/heading_style` — text — `heading_style`: Style description for headings (e.g., bold, uppercase)
          - `theme/typography/body_style` — text — `body_style`: Style description for body text
        - `theme/layout` — structure slide_designer.LayoutSettings — `layout`: Layout configuration
          - `theme/layout/aspect_ratio` — choice of "16:9" | "4:3" | "1:1" — `aspect_ratio`: Slide aspect ratio
          - `theme/layout/margins` — text — `margins`: Margin style (e.g., narrow, standard, wide)
          - `theme/layout/alignment` — text — `alignment`: Default content alignment (e.g., left, center, right)
        - `theme/style` — structure slide_designer.StyleSettings — `style`: Visual style settings
          - `theme/style/overall` — text — `overall`: Overall visual style (e.g., minimal, corporate, creative)
          - `theme/style/icon_style` — text — `icon_style`: Style for icons (e.g., outline, filled, flat)
          - `theme/style/graphic_style` — text — `graphic_style`: Style for graphics and illustrations
        - `theme/exclusions` — text — `exclusions`: Elements to avoid in the design (e.g., no gradients, no stock photos)
      - `mockup` — image (a file) — `mockup`: A title slide drawn in the theme

## Delegated

None. `MthdsResult` remains available for any structure you choose not to lay out.

## One real run, as loaded

The state of one actual run, so you can judge magnitudes and lengths. Bind to the paths; do not copy these values into the spec.
